description: The steps the trader's last tested strategy took on one market, as the test engine reported them: each step's time, the move (ready to in a trade, and so on), the conditions true at that bar, the trade it opened or closed, and the watched items' values at that bar. Also, per watched item, its average at the entries of winning trades and of losing trades. Use it to answer 'what was the RSI when it bought', 'why did it enter there', 'what do the winners have in common'. These are past bars of one tested week: a description, never a forecast and never advice.

market.description: the market the strategy was tested on (defaults to the newest test)

only.description: trades = only the steps that opened or closed a trade (default); all = every step

name: strategy_steps
